thread_text:
alex: FYI prepping the release notes + internalannounce for v2.3.1. Change window Mon 23:00 UTC. Need short RN, deploybot commands, precise pin header, and rollback bullets. Who can draft the blast?

nina: I'll take the blast + RN bullets. Will post a link in ~30m.

lee: Canary proposal: 10% for 20m -> 50% for 20m -> full. Health gates: error_rate > 2% (5m) OR p95 latency +120ms => pause and evaluate. OOM spikes trigger immediate pause.

maya: Add dedicated customer note: header to pin runtime `x-rw-runtime: rif-runtime@3c7f`. SDK examples + curl snippet please.

deploybot: Scheduled: v2.3.1 canary=10% start=2024-11-04T23:00:00Z. Command suggestion: `/deploy v2.3.1 --canary=10% --stages=50%,100% --stage-duration=20m`

nina: Draft blurb: "v2.3.1: KV-cache fixes and streaming efficiency (~10% token cost). Pinned runtime: rif-runtime@3c7f. Fallback: rif-quant-v2. Oncall: @lee @maya. Internal announce will go 20m before window."

opsbot: Automation rules saved: error_rate > 2% (5m), p95_delta > 120ms (5m), oom_count > 0 (3m). Auto-rollback requires two rules firing.

lee: Paste small rollback runbook in RN: 1) `/deploybot pause --id {{id}}` 2) `/deploybot rollback --to v2.3.0` 3) notify #eng-oncall + CSMs 4) gather logs & tag incident. Keep it copy/paste.

maya: I'll own customer SDK snippets and the Dedicated header instructions.

nina: Draft posted: https://rwd.internal/releases/drafts/v2.3.1-rn-brief  please review. Planning internal announce at 22:40 UTC unless issues.

alex: Quick staging smoke now, will report in 10m. If green, approve for blast.

deploybot: Note: blackout enforcement active. Manual override required for blackouts.

lee: Observability quick-checks for RN: `query("rate(runtime_errors[5m])")` and `query("histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m]))")`.

nina: Added those queries and the ops checklist to the draft. Final review at 22:30 UTC then I will post.

alex: Staging looks clean, no OOMs. :thumbsup:

deploybot: Canary started (10%) -> monitoring hooks enabled. Good luck! :rocket:
